title: Principles Of Crop Production
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major weed control method used in crop production in many parts of the tropics."
Hand pulling is a major weed control method used in crop production in many parts of the tropics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used intact or after having the upper part cut off to facilitate loading and unloading."
Plastic drums are used intact or after having the upper part cut off to facilitate loading and unloading.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most effective practical method for controlling many farm weeds."
Crop rotation is the most effective practical method for controlling many farm weeds.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all weeding operations where the power used for removing weeds is derived from machines which in turn are using fossil fuel as source of energy."
Machine-powered weeding refers to all weeding operations where the power used for removing weeds is derived from machines which in turn are using fossil fuel as source of energy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount of injury done to a crop which will justify the cost of artificial control measures."
Economic damage is the amount of injury done to a crop which will justify the cost of artificial control measures.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the lowest pest population density that will cause economic damage to a crop and this varies from crop to crop, season to season, and area to area."
The economic injury level is the lowest pest population density that will cause economic damage to a crop and this varies from crop to crop, season to season, and area to area.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an effective method for controlling certain weeds."
Pasturing land with sheep sometimes is an effective method for controlling certain weeds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those herbicides that exert toxic effects on all plants that may come in contact with them."
Nonselective herbicides are those herbicides that exert toxic effects on all plants that may come in contact with them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common way of drying grain after harvesting and threshing."
Drying on flat exposed surfaces is the most common way of drying grain after harvesting and threshing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the methods of managing extremely sloping land for crop production."
Terracing is one of the methods of managing extremely sloping land for crop production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a limiting factor for crop production where irrigation is not available."
Water generally is a limiting factor for crop production where irrigation is not available.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the types most frequently used for intertillage."
Shovel or sweep cultivators are the types most frequently used for intertillage.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the population density at which control measures should be started to prevent an increasing pest population from reaching the economic injury level."
Economic threshold is defined as the population density at which control measures should be started to prevent an increasing pest population from reaching the economic injury level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a plant growing where man does not want it."
A weed is a plant growing where man does not want it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a useful method of breeding when it is desired to add only one or two new characters to an otherwise desirable variety."
Backcrossing is a useful method of breeding when it is desired to add only one or two new characters to an otherwise desirable variety.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the act of preserving and keeping agricultural produce or any commodity for future use without necessarily losing its quality."
Storage may be defined as the act of preserving and keeping agricultural produce or any commodity for future use without necessarily losing its quality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a determinant factor in the growth, development and crop yield."
Too much or too little moisture is a determinant factor in the growth, development and crop yield.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a crop production system in which a food crop is planted directly in the living cover of an established cover crop without destruction of the fallow (cover crop) vegetation."
Live mulch is defined as a crop production system in which a food crop is planted directly in the living cover of an established cover crop without destruction of the fallow (cover crop) vegetation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a quick method of purifying or improving mixed or un-adapted crop varieties."
Mass selection is a quick method of purifying or improving mixed or un-adapted crop varieties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as a protective covering over the soil surface that is intended to minimise evaporation losses."
Mulch may be defined as a protective covering over the soil surface that is intended to minimise evaporation losses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the substances used for correcting the acidity or alkalinity of the soil."
Soil amendments are the substances used for correcting the acidity or alkalinity of the soil.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with preventing or at least restricting the development of plant disease epidemics."
Plant disease control is concerned with preventing or at least restricting the development of plant disease epidemics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a few hundred kg per hour."
The output is a few hundred kg per hour.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication of poor pre- and post-harvest management and supervision, e.g. seed selection, lot segregation and treatment, contamination, etc."
A mixture is an indication of poor pre- and post-harvest management and supervision, e.g. seed selection, lot segregation and treatment, contamination, etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a group of extremely minute particles which are visible only through a powerful electron."
Viruses are a group of extremely minute particles which are visible only through a powerful electron.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known as 'through-flow' threshers because stalks and ears pass through the machine."
The machines of Western design are known as 'through-flow' threshers because stalks and ears pass through the machine.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication of the health of the seedlings and of the likelihood that they will yield well."
The seedling vigour assessment is an indication of the health of the seedlings and of the likelihood that they will yield well.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in food crops for control of over grown annual weeds."
slashing is used in food crops for control of over grown annual weeds.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the means by which soil and subsoil -water is controlled in, and removed from, the root zone in relation to the health and vigour of the crop."
Drainage may be defined as the means by which soil and subsoil -water is controlled in, and removed from, the root zone in relation to the health and vigour of the crop.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of segregating desired types from mixed varieties."
Pure-line selection offers a quick means of segregating desired types from mixed varieties.
fib: ______ is made up straw that has been used for bedding and dung.
solid portion
The solid portion is made up straw that has been used for bedding and dung.
______ is one of the oldest methods of weed control and consists of hand pulling, hand slashing and hoeing and mowing of weeds.
Hand weeding
Hand weeding is one of the oldest methods of weed control and consists of hand pulling, hand slashing and hoeing and mowing of weeds.
______ is a measure of the amount of water delivered by irrigation that actually ends up as available water to the plant.
Irrigation efficiency
Irrigation efficiency is a measure of the amount of water delivered by irrigation that actually ends up as available water to the plant.
______ is a third factor that may influence the time of planting.
Day length or photoperiod
Day length or photoperiod is a third factor that may influence the time of planting.
______ is defined as changing the soil condition with a tool for the benefit of man.
Tillage
Tillage is defined as changing the soil condition with a tool for the benefit of man.
______ refers to seeds while planting is used when vegetative parts are involved.
terms sowing
The terms sowing refers to seeds while planting is used when vegetative parts are involved.
______ can be defined as the acceptable use of practicable measures to minimise, cost-effectively, the losses caused by pests in a particular management system.
Integrated pest control
Integrated pest control can be defined as the acceptable use of practicable measures to minimise, cost-effectively, the losses caused by pests in a particular management system.
______ is a popular and inexpensive roofing material in many areas and when painted black forms an excellent solar absorber.
Corrugated iron
Corrugated iron is a popular and inexpensive roofing material in many areas and when painted black forms an excellent solar absorber.
______ is the percentage of seeds sown that eventually emerge.
final percentage emergence
The final percentage emergence is the percentage of seeds sown that eventually emerge.
______ are a drawback to the purchase of farm machinery.
Economic constraints
Economic constraints are a drawback to the purchase of farm machinery.
______ refers to both the accidental forest (bush) fires and the type of burning deliberately started in the dry season of the savanna for hunting purposes.
Uncontrolled burning
Uncontrolled burning refers to both the accidental forest (bush) fires and the type of burning deliberately started in the dry season of the savanna for hunting purposes.
______ refers to those measures necessary to prevent the introduction of new weed species into a given geographical area as well as multiplication and spread of existing weed species.
Preventive weed control

Preventive weed control refers to those measures necessary to prevent the introduction of new weed species into a given geographical area as well as multiplication and spread of existing weed species.
______ are those that will preferentially kill certain plants species at recommended rates but will not harm other plants that they come in contact with.
Selective herbicides
Selective herbicides are those that will preferentially kill certain plants species at recommended rates but will not harm other plants that they come in contact with.
______ is a pod that contains one or several seeds.
fruit
The fruit is a pod that contains one or several seeds.
______ is the source of all other certified seed classes, either directly or through registered seed.
Foundation seed
Foundation seed is the source of all other certified seed classes, either directly or through registered seed.
______ is the eradication of suspected sources of plant diseases.
important cultural practiced
An important cultural practiced is the eradication of suspected sources of plant diseases.
______ is the outer covering of the seed.
testa
The testa is the outer covering of the seed.
______ is used extensively in forestry to reduce the accumulation of litter and reduce the risk of wild fires that could destroy forests and property.
Controlled burning
Controlled burning is used extensively in forestry to reduce the accumulation of litter and reduce the risk of wild fires that could destroy forests and property.
______ are those cut and preserved in succulent condition by partial fermentation.
Silage crops
Silage crops are those cut and preserved in succulent condition by partial fermentation.
______ refers to the control or suppression of weeds by the action of one or more organisms, through natural means or by manipulation of the weed, organism, or the environment.
Biological method of weed control

Biological method of weed control refers to the control or suppression of weeds by the action of one or more organisms, through natural means or by manipulation of the weed, organism, or the environment.
______ are the basic foundation upon which successful crop production is laid.
Seeds and other planting materials
Seeds and other planting materials are the basic foundation upon which successful crop production is laid.
______ is a troublesome sucking insect pest of cotton.
cotton stainer
The cotton stainer is a troublesome sucking insect pest of cotton.
______ is one of the major causes of food shortages and low agricultural supply in the world.
Poor storage
Poor storage is one of the major causes of food shortages and low agricultural supply in the world.
______ is the only effective means of combining the desirable characters of two crop varieties.
Hybridisation
Hybridisation is the only effective means of combining the desirable characters of two crop varieties.
______ refers to the use of living organisms for the control of pests; it involves the use of predators, which feed on harmful insects and reduce their numbers to a minimum.
Biological control
Biological control refers to the use of living organisms for the control of pests; it involves the use of predators, which feed on harmful insects and reduce their numbers to a minimum.
______ is concerned mainly with more abundant, stable and economical crop production, but is also deeply motivated by social and humane wants.
Crop breeding
Crop breeding is concerned mainly with more abundant, stable and economical crop production, but is also deeply motivated by social and humane wants.
______ is any animal or plant which harm or causes damage to man, his animals, crops, or possession.
Pest
Pest is any animal or plant which harm or causes damage to man, his animals, crops, or possession.
______ is an integral part of sustainable crop production process.
Soil and water conservation
Soil and water conservation is an integral part of sustainable crop production process.
______ refers to the spraying of the leaves of growing plants with suitable fertiliser solutions.
Foliar application
Foliar application refers to the spraying of the leaves of growing plants with suitable fertiliser solutions.
______ is a labour-intensive operation but is less arduous than threshing.
Harvesting
Harvesting is a labour-intensive operation but is less arduous than threshing.
According to the course material, how many types of solar dryer appropriate for use with grain are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two basic types of solar dryer appropriate for use with grain: natural convection dryers where the air flow is induced by thermal gradients; and forced convection dryers wherein air is forced through a solar collector and the grain bed by a fan.
